parity.reason: Comparator (Front Psychiatry 2026, PMID 42490943) acute MADRS-change-from-baseline Day-28 primary pooled 4 RCTs (N=937, MD -2.99 [-5.10,-0.88]; verified in its own results table '937 (4 RCTs)'). We pool 2 (TRANSFORM-2 flexible-dose [positive], TRANSFORM-3 elderly). The 2 gap trials (TRANSFORM-1 and the phase-2 dose-finding) are 3-arm FIXED-DOSE (56/84 mg) designs: our multi-arm continuous guard refuses per-arm extraction because we pool the approved FLEXIBLE-dose estimand, not a single fixed-dose arm. Both are in the corpus, declared-absent with reason - design/estimand exclusion, not a search miss. [our_k = our full pooled k (4); of these, 2 (TRANSFORM-2, TRANSFORM-3 flexible-dose) match the comparator's acute Day-28 MADRS scope — the same-scope subset used for the fair comparison].
